---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Anchor
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**The problem**
What can't you (or your agents) do today? A concrete scenario beats a general idea.

**The idea**
What you'd like Anchor to do differently.

**Why it matters**
Who benefits, and how much — one line is enough.

**Alternatives you've tried**
Workarounds or other tools you've considered.

**Constraint check**
Anchor is free-tier only. Does this idea stay within free tiers (Workers, Pages, Supabase, Turso)? If you're not sure, say so.
